senses.gloss: रेच &c. See p. 887, col. 1.
रेच m. the emptying of the lungs by exhalation (see next), emission of breath, AmṛtUp.
रेच रेचक &c. See col. 1.
रेचित &c. See p. 887, col. 1.
रेचित mfn. (fr. Caus.) emptied, purged, cleared, W.
left, abandoned, Ragh.; Śiś.
रेचित m. (scil. हस्त) N. of a partic. position of the hands in dancing, Cat.
रेचित n. N. of one of a horse's paces, cantering, Kād.
रेचिता f. contraction of one eye-brow, L.
रेचक mf(इका)n. emptying, purging, aperient, cathartic, L.
emptying the lungs, emitting the breath, L.
रेचक m. the act of breathing out, exhalation, VarBṛS.
(esp.) expelling the breath out of one of the nostrils (one of the three Prāṇāyāmas [q.v.] or breath-exercises performed during Saṃdhyā), AmṛtUp.; BhP. &c., RTL. 402
a syringe, BhP.
a partic. movement of the feet, VP.
saltpetre, L.
Croton Jamalgota, L.
Clerodendrum Phlomoides, L.
N. of a forester, Vikr. (v.l. रेधक)
रेचक m. pl. N. of a people, MBh. (B. आरोचक)
रेचक n. a kind of soil or earth, L.
the fruit of the yellow myrobalan, L.
a purge, cathartic, W.
रेचक m. or n. (?) = भ्रमण, Harav. (cf. next).
रेचकित mfn. = भ्रमित, Vām. iv, 1, 2.
रेचन mf(ई)n. purging, cathartic, aperient, Suśr.
clearing (the head), Car.
रेचन n. the act of emptying, lessening, exhausting, Kām.
emission of breath, exhalation, Yogas., Sch. (cf. रेच and रेचक)
purging, evacuation, Suśr.; Sarvad.
clearing (the head), Car.
a kind of earth, L.
mucus, Gal.
रेचनी f. N. of various plants (Ipomoea Turpethum; Croton Polyandrum; = कालाञनी, गुन्द्रा, काम्पिल्ल &c.), L.
रेचनक m. a kind of red powder, L. (cf. रेचिन्).
रेचिन् m. Alangium Hexapetalum, L.
a kind of red powder, L. (cf. रेचनक).
रेच्य m. = रेच, L.
